<!-- One concern per pull request. A change to the format changes FORMAT.md first. Write each paragraph on one line. -->

**Problem.** What is missing or wrong, for someone who has not followed the discussion.

**Change.** What changes, in a few points.

**How to verify.** A command or step a reader can repeat, and what they should see.

**Notes.** Side effects, open questions, what this leaves out. Delete if empty.
